crossRefs.note: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David…
crossRefs.keyword: or, as some suppose, when beyond Jordan

crossRefs.note: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go…

translations.web: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!
translations.kjv: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.
translations.asv: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.
